## 2. TechServices Password Reset Link

I found two emails related to this. The legitimate-looking one is from **support@techservices.com** (received 2024-05-19, subject "TechServices Password Reset Request"):

**Reset link:** https://techservices.com/auth/password-reset/token=?asfbuy3y2cdaqhvei

⚠️ **Caution:** There's a second email from **tech-services-password@aol.com** (an "alternative address") also claiming to contain a reset link (https://techservices.com/auth/password-reset/token=?fjahwb24jab3). This is a classic phishing pattern — a non-official domain impersonating Tech Services. I'd recommend using only the link from the official `techservices.com` sender, and not clicking the AOL one.
